name: For me
source:
Mo Yao regretted her efforts to get into her mother's alma mater because of the conflict between them, and decided to spend her high school years alone. Shortly after enrolling, however, she unexpectedly joined the long-established Haicheng Astronomy Club, where she discovered her mother's stargazing diary.

[Translated from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2092090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
由于与母亲之间的冲突，墨耀后悔自己努力考进了母亲的母校，决心独自度过高中生活。然而，入学不久，她却意外加入了历史悠久的海城天文社，并在那里发现了母亲留下的观星日记。

[译自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2092090/]Steam[/url]]
